plan.title: SRC-NEG-007 Counter Offer Rejected During Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with the vendor's existing normal bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer changing Vendor A's price from the existing bid to 90.
Verify the buyer grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer is available to the vendor.

args.need: as Vendor A, open the pending counter offer and click Reject; stop when the portal shows the rejection completed

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor-side reject-counter-offer action or assertion.
Return to the buyer's event page after the vendor rejection.
Return to the RFQ Responses tab to inspect the post-rejection buyer state.
Verify the buyer can initiate another counter offer after the vendor's rejection.
Open Master QCS to verify the bid value shown after rejection.
Verify Vendor A's original price remains 100 in the buyer's comparison grid.
